title: Welcome to HaruCMS
excerpt: Get started with HaruCMS and discover the power of flat-file content management.
content:
HaruCMS is a modern, flat-file content management system designed for simplicity and flexibility. With no database required, you can get up and running in minutes.

Key features include:

  • Fast and lightweight
  • Easy to deploy
  • Flexible content structure
  • Beautiful admin interface
author: Admin
